summary.text: Historical data is provided by S&P Global Market Intelligence. Real-time stock price data is provided by CBOE and 15-minute delayed consolidated tape pricing data is provided by Nasdaq UTP. Several fund data points are also provided by Finnhub.

overview.description: The Toyota Motor Corporation ADRhedged (TMH) is an exchange-traded fund that mostly invests in consumer discretionary equity. The fund provides exposure to Toyota Motor Corp. ADR, while using swaps to hedge daily currency fluctuations TMH was launched on Mar 13, 2025 and is issued by ADRhedged.
